NOUGHTVAULT  //  PATTERN · KEPALA BAND

The kepala band

Twelve pucuk rebung across 306 mm — one band. The print carries two, facing each other across the badan, so the border counts to twenty-four: one per word of a 24-word recovery phrase. It counts to 24; it does not store 24, and no copy may ever imply otherwise. Band depth 76 mm including an 8 mm plinth of 61 cecek.
